name: query-inspector
description: A Claude Code skill and plugin for SQL and ORM query tuning. It inspects the SQL and ORM-generated queries in your changes. Two skills: tuning-report (catch missing indexes, N+1s, anti-patterns before commit, with an optional live-DB EXPLAIN tier) and inventory-report (catalog project queries with purpose, target tables, and index coverage). Incremental by default; Kotlin/Java + MyBatis / native SQL / JPA (QueryDSL, Kotlin JDSL); dialect auto-detection.
